title: Critical points are not critical values
promptMarkdown: For $f(x,y)=x^2y$, compute the critical set and the critical values. Describe every nonzero level as a smooth curve with an explicit parametrization of each component. Describe the zero level and explain where the regular-value theorem applies and where it makes no claim.
hintLadder: Set both first derivatives to zero.
On a nonzero level solve for $y$ in terms of $x$.
A singular value can still contain regular points.
